evals.prompt: Run a security audit on my FloodPulse mobile app
evals.expected_output: Skill runs pass 1, produces SECURITY_AUDIT.md at the project root with findings classified Critical/High/Medium/Low. Each finding cites a CWE. If any Critical or High findings exist, skill enters pass 2 to apply fixes, then pass 3 to verify no new issues were introduced.

evals.prompt: Is this safe to ship to TestFlight
evals.expected_output: Skill runs the audit and prints a GREEN/RED verdict. RED if any Critical or High remains. The verdict prints with a list of remaining items. GREEN includes the valid-until date seven days out.

evals.prompt: Check this project for vulnerabilities before I push to Apple
evals.expected_output: Skill runs the full three-pass audit. Refuses to print a clean verdict unless pass 3 added zero new Critical or High findings. Output saved to SECURITY_AUDIT.md.
